messages:
Incident Bot: Pager alert (INC-7891) — inference-proxy us-east-1: elevated 5xx rate and increased latency. Triggered 1763456720. Impact approx 1-3% of prod requests. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/inference-proxy — follow 'Mitigation -> Quick fallback' first.
Priya Nair: I'm the primary oncall. Heads-up: I need to step out for ~45m (doctor appt). Can Alex take primary for that window? There's an ongoing spike so prefer an overlap handoff.
Alex Chen: I can take it. I have 10m to prep, then I'll assume primary. Maya — you ok staying secondary while I cover?
Maya Patel: Yep, I'll stay secondary and keep eyes on dashboards (latency, error-rate, cache hit). If error rate >5% I'll escalate to Jordan.
Priya Nair: Giving context: root-cause unknown, early signs of kv-cache misses after recent deploy. Telemetry link: https://telemetry/company/prod/inference-proxy
Priya Nair: Quick checklist before handoff: 1) confirm active canary fallback available 2) ensure primary pager reassigned 3) share Kibana query for recent errors.
Priya Nair: Kibana query (paste):
```
index:prod-* | filter service:inference-proxy and status:[500 TO 599] | last 15m | group_by:route
```
Priya Nair: Runbook snippet to trigger fallback:
```
# fallback: switch-route -> inference-proxy-canary
curl -X POST https://ops-api.company/route/fallback -d '{"route":"inference","variant":"canary"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN'
```
Alex Chen: I'm going to run the health checks now and reassign pager.
Alex Chen: `pctl handoff --from priya --to alex --duration 45m` — executed, pager reassigned. I'm primary now. :eyes:
Alex Chen: I'm pinging Jordan to stand by in case we need infra-level rollback.
Jordan Rivera: Got it. I'll be on standby for rollback and infra escalation. If we need kernel-level restarts I'll take it.
Maya Patel: Noted. I'm watching prefix cache miss rate — it's trending up but still under the alert threshold. If it breaches, I'll trigger the failover step.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. Logging out to head to appointment. Leaving runbook pointers in thread. Ping me if anything critical.
Priya Nair: :wave:
Alex Chen: Quick notes for whoever picks up next: 1) check redis-cluster-03 latency > 200ms 2) check `kv-cache-hit-rate` dashboard 3) if fallback triggered, confirm traffic flows to canary and monitor errors for new patterns.
Alex Chen: If fallback is insufficient, plan B is to rollback the latest inference-proxy deployment (deploy id: deploy-2026-04-18-19). Jordan, you have the rollback playbook?
Jordan Rivera: Yep, I have rollback creds and playbook. Steps:
1) pause autoscaler
2) roll back inference-proxy to deploy-2026-04-17-22
3) monitor for errors to drop to baseline
I'll only run it on command from primary + runbook confirmation.
Alex Chen: Understood. For now, I'm keeping primary, will attempt a controlled canary fallback in 10m if error rate doesn't trend down.
Maya Patel: Adding small note — there's a 30m TZ overlap gap if Priya extends out; we have 15m overlap now between Priya (CEST) and me/Alex (PDT). If Priya is late, Alex will continue as primary until she's back.
Alex Chen: Acknowledge. I'll post an update in 8–10m after the next metric bucket.
Incident Bot: Reminder: add incident label `oncall-handoff` and set severity in PagerDuty if escalation occurs.
Alex Chen: Update 1763457120: canary fallback tested in staging, initiating gradual fallback to canary (10% -> 50%). Monitoring.
Maya Patel: I see error rate stabilizing at ~0.9% post 10% shift. Continuing watch.
Alex Chen: 1763457420 — error rate holding low, rolling back fallback pause. I'll keep primary for another 15m to ensure stability, then hand back to Priya if she's back. If anything spikes, I'll escalate.
Priya Nair: I'm back online in ~10m. Thanks for the clean handoff; appreciate the notes. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Great — will hand back once you're fully reachable. Leaving final ops note in thread for audit.
